6bc1e3b097.why: The four indexed loads, two signed-saturating multiply-adds, sum, store, accumulation, and three required scalar updates have no removable instruction.

28c96672db.why: Each instruction supplies a required store, accumulator value, pointer value, or counter value and flags.

b85152afaf.why: The indexed loads already use memory-source lane inserts, and both multiply-add results feed the required sum, store, and accumulator.

be3143a27e.why: The partial loads, lane inserts, saturating multiply-adds, sum, and arbitrary byte shuffle are needed to produce the stored and accumulated vector.

a244902e9d.why: The store, vector accumulation, pointer increment, and counter subtraction each produce a required effect.

527ff15df8.why: Folding the loads into VPMADDUBSW would swap its unsigned and signed operands, while the remaining instructions produce required outputs.

08a723d92c.why: All four instructions are needed for the store, accumulator, pointer, and decremented counter with matching flags.

d514955fca.why: Two VPHADDD instructions replace two shuffles and two additions while preserving the low-dword sum used by the final broadcast. The rounding term, shift count, and all required register values remain unchanged.

e9dc3b8df4.why: VPSUBW cannot fold the minuend load into its memory operand, and the store plus both scalar updates are required.

78d9989b6f.why: The four indexed loads construct two separately multiplied, stored, and accumulated vectors, with all three scalar updates also required.

c77226b34e.why: Memory-source lane inserts already combine loading and assembly, and both vector results, stores, accumulations, and scalar updates are required.

c5ac795edd.why: Both vectors require their partial loads, lane inserts, saturating multiply-adds, and arbitrary byte shuffles before the required stores and accumulations.

db418fc3f7.why: The source loads cannot be folded into VPMADDUBSW without reversing byte signedness, and both stores, accumulations, and scalar updates are live.

a63a7c10d3.why: Two distinct stores, two independent accumulator updates, and two required scalar updates already take one instruction each.
